Nate (Docs): Quick heads-up: I put together a short migration note focused on the SDK param rename and embed schema changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4230. Need the exact fields and a tiny example so we avoid churn in snippets.

Irene (SDK): TL;DR: param `model` -> `modelName`. Embed response changed from `dim` to `meta.version` and `model` -> `modelName`. Example old vs new below.

Nate (Docs): Paste the minimal JSONs here please.

Irene (SDK): Old:
```
{ "model": "redwood-embed-v1", "embedding": [0.0, 0.1, ...], "dim": 1536 }
```
New:
```
{ "modelName": "redwood-embed-v2", "embedding": [0.0, 0.1, ...], "meta": { "version": "v2" } }
```

Theo (PM): Timeline reminder: deprecation announcement 2026-03-31, enforcement 2026-04-15. Docs + SDK need to be in sync by announcement.

Nate (Docs): I'll add a tiny QA checklist and the codemod link. Irene, can you confirm the exact console warn string so customers can grep?

Irene (SDK): Use: "[redwood-sdk] DEPRECATION: 'model' param is deprecated. Use 'modelName'. See https://redwood.ai/docs/deprecations"

build-bot: Preview deployed for PR #4230: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/deprecations/4230 - checks: 6 passed

Nate (Docs): Great, merging after I add the snippet and QA checklist. Thanks!
